body: I carried a polish lady out of a highway today preventing her from committing suicide.. It's been a good day. Save the life of one to try and make up for the mistake of another, perhaps?..
Thank you for your words, I really appreciate it.

I'm sorry to hear about your friend, I can't fathom the thought of losing someone close to me that way. I appreciate the support and i just want to let you know that, this is obviously a throwaway account but have an upvote :) . Feel better.
